message: The emulation shows the design itself is sound: there are no failures, and the board still keeps the full end-to-end flow. Every blocker is there because the tool has no native generator for this IBM Cloud pull-request reviewer (Code Engine, Secrets Manager, watsonx.ai, IBM Cloud Logs). Changing the graph can't fix that, and the narrow storage-only setup would cut the scope, so we won't use it. Closing that gap is product engineering work: someone needs to build the generator and runtime code, with this artifact (ae8a69f8…, revision 2) as the reproducer. The first gap is the repo → reviewer connection. Which Git host and trigger should that connection use: GitHub with a webhook, GitLab, or something else? That choice sets the read-only token scope and the first acceptance test.
